## What it is

**What it is:** A TV-series manager (PVR): it watches RSS feeds and indexers for new episodes, sends them to a download client, then renames and files them into the library.

**Sub-tags:** downloads (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1).

**Icon:** `icon.svg` is a neutral generated initials icon, not the upstream logo.

## How it is packaged

- **Image:** `ghcr.io/linuxserver/sonarr`, the LinuxServer image that upstream's wiki lists for Docker (https://wiki.servarr.com/sonarr/installation/docker). Upstream publishes no image of its own.
- **Non-root:** the image README supports starting as a non-root user ("Non-Root Operation"); the pod starts as 1000:1000, so `PUID`/`PGID` have no effect, and `LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER=1` is set explicitly because the image only detects non-root from a non-root-owned `/run`, which an `emptyDir` never is. s6-overlay 3.2.1.0 needs a writable `/run`: an `emptyDir`, which Kubernetes creates root-owned and group-writable, so `S6_YES_I_WANT_A_WORLD_WRITABLE_RUN_BECAUSE_KUBERNETES=1` lets its `preinit` accept it.
- **State:** PVC `sonarr-config` (`/config`: database, settings, backups), `sonarr-tv` (`/tv`) and `sonarr-downloads` (`/downloads`), the folders in the image README.
- **Health:** probes on `GET /ping`, which needs no login (`src/Sonarr.Http/Ping/PingController.cs`).
- **Security:** `runAsNonRoot`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all Linux capabilities dropped, `RuntimeDefault` seccomp, no service-account token. One replica with the `Recreate` strategy, so two pods never write the same volume.

## First run

From the upstream documentation, https://wiki.servarr.com/sonarr/quick-start-guide:

1. Open the web UI and set up authentication (Forms, user name and password) when it asks.
2. Add indexers (or connect Prowlarr), a download client, and the root folder `/tv`.

## Known limits in this package

- Each OneMind app has its own namespace and volumes, so this app cannot yet see another app's download folder (for example qBittorrent's). Imports from a download client need a shared folder, which OneMind does not offer yet.

## Why this app is blocked

The CI app gate (`sdk/tools/app-gate`, contract §9.4) computed tier **blocked** for this app on 2026-11-12 (ci-apps run 43216348408, job `gate (sonarr)`). The gateway lists a blocked app in the Market but refuses to install it (§10.3, §11.1). The app is kept, not hidden, and the gate was not weakened. Reasons from that run:

- Vulnerability: `ghcr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.20.3014-ls329`: CVE-2026-111497 in `brotli-libs` 1.2.0-r1 (fixed 1.2.1-r0).
- Smoke test failed (ci-apps run 43216348408): the pod ran but port 8989 refused connections for 10 minutes, no restarts. Cause, reproduced locally with the same image, UID 1000, dropped capabilities and an `emptyDir` on `/run`: the image only takes its non-root branch when `/run` is owned by a non-root uid (`LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER` is set by `/docker-mods` from `stat /run -c %u`). A Kubernetes `emptyDir` is root-owned, so the root-only init (`usermod`, `s6-setuidgid abc`) ran, failed without `CAP_SETGID`, and the service looped on `s6-applyuidgid: fatal: unable to set supplementary group list: Operation not permitted`. Fix in this change: the manifest sets `LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER=1`; locally `/ping` then returns 200 with no such errors. Not yet confirmed by a gate run.
- Licence: GitHub GPL-3.0 matches, but there is no research licence-matrix row, so the app is not preinstallable on sold boxes until one is added (brief 30 B10). ClamAV 0 infected.

To unblock: the startup failure is fixed above (rerun the gate to confirm); move the image pin to a release with the fix (tag verified with `crane`), and add a licence-matrix row. Then rerun `sdk/tools/app-gate`.

**Hold (apps/market-unblock-2, 2026-11-13):** `brotli-libs` CVE-2026-111497 (fixed in 1.2.1-r0), gate run 43405572161. The smoke test passes. `4.0.20.3014-ls329` is the newest tag. Unblock: a LinuxServer rebuild on a newer Alpine. The registry was re-read on 2026-11-13: the pinned digest is unchanged and no newer fixed tag exists, so nothing is bumped (the gate was not weakened and the tier was not edited). It unblocks when the weekly `apps-rescan` or a manual `apps-gate-all` run computes a pass on a rebuilt image. No upstream issue link was looked up (the GitHub API is not reachable from the worker).
